UPDATE access.notification_outbox AS n
SET
  status = 'sent',
  slack_message_ts = $3,
  lease_token = NULL,
  leased_until = NULL,
  processing_execution_id = NULL,
  last_error_code = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE n.id = $1::uuid
  AND n.lease_token = $2::uuid
  AND n.processing_execution_id = $4
  AND n.status = 'processing'
  AND n.leased_until > NOW()
RETURNING
  n.id AS notification_id,
  n.message_id,
  n.kind,
  n.status,
  n.attempts,
  n.slack_message_ts;

UPDATE access.notification_outbox AS n
SET
  status = CASE
    WHEN n.attempts >= 3 THEN 'failed'
    ELSE 'pending'
  END,
  available_at = NOW()
    + INTERVAL '30 seconds' * n.attempts,
  lease_token = NULL,
  leased_until = NULL,
  processing_execution_id = NULL,
  last_error_code = 'slack_delivery_failed',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE n.status = 'processing'
  AND n.processing_execution_id = $1
  AND n.leased_until > NOW()
RETURNING
  n.id AS notification_id,
  n.message_id,
  n.kind,
  n.status,
  n.attempts,
  n.available_at,
  n.last_error_code;
